title: Upper bound for the learning sample count
statement: For every $n,\ell\in\mathbb{N}$ and every rational learning parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq\frac12$, the sample count $2^\ell$ times the sum of the number of subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$ and $\lceil\log_2\lceil2/\delta\rceil\rceil$ is at most $2^\ell\big((\ell+1)(n+1)^\ell+\lceil\log_2\lceil2/\delta\rceil\rceil\big)$.
